agencyName: Iowa Legislative Services Agency (Iowa Administrative Code, Chapter 481—401, administered by DIAL's Electrical Examining Board)
authorityRationale: The codified Iowa Administrative Code chapter governing electrician/electrical-contractor licensing requirements, procedures, and fees (481—401), effective 5/22/24 and current per the 7/9/25 IAC Supplement, published directly by Iowa's own Legislative Services Agency at legis.iowa.gov — a .gov original, not a third-party mirror (contrast with utah-admin-code-r156-1-302, which is cited via a Cornell Law School mirror because Utah's own rule-hosting sites were unreachable). Contains the actual reciprocal-licensing procedure (401.2(14) journeyman / 401.2(15) master), exam-score thresholds, the separate Licensure-by-Verification pathway (401.9), and the license-term/fee table (401.3).
reliabilityRationale: Primary codified regulatory text from the state's own legislative publisher — the highest-reliability source type used in this dataset. The one caveat: its stated reciprocal-application conditions (apprenticeship-or-16,000-hours prong) diverge from the board's own reciprocity PDF, which does not mention that prong — see requiredExperience needs_review flag.
